title: Chapter 754
paragraphs: Chapter 754
Episode 185. The Remaining People (4)
"The old steward of the family...?"

"Runtya Runcandel, my sister and the 3rd-generation Knight, and Leuth Damiro Yul, the steward of the first-generation family head, are trapped in separate subspaces. I'll find them as soon as the announcement is over."
He had to find Runtya first.
Since the Demon God had died, there was a high possibility of a problem with the soul that was keeping her alive.
However, the most fearful fact was that Runtya already had a horn. With the current purification process, Runtya could not be returned to her original state due to her physical transformation.
'My sister can be properly rescued when she can merge with the god, or after her half-brother comes out.'
But if she's alive, there's always a chance she can be returned.
Jin held onto that hope.
"Great-grandfather and Alpen, please take charge of the Black Sword Society and the Law Enforcement Society from now on."
While conducting the appointment ceremony, Jin confirmed the survival of Telot Runcandel, the chairman of the Homin Society.
For now, Balas and Alpen were the best options for the remaining two chairmanships.
[Alright.]
[I understand that you're asking me to manage and prepare a successor in advance.]
"Exactly, Sir Alpen. And Sir Tasha, please take charge of the Chief Instructor of Saengdo."
The position of 'Chief Instructor of Saengdo' might seem a bit light for a previous family head to take.
But Jin thought the nurturing of talent was more urgent than ever, and the previous heads of the family thought the same.
[I take it as an honor.]
"If word gets out that Sir Tasha is personally training, not only Saengdos but also active knights will flock to him."
We need to replenish manpower.
To wage war against major forces in the future, and to protect the people who have come to Runcandel looking at Jin.
[That's likely. But my standards are very high and selection will be strict. You should know that replenishment might be a bit slower than you think.]
"Of course. That's the reason why I appointed you as the Chief Instructor in the first place. Show your discernment as a previous family head."
[I feel the weight on my shoulders, but you can expect good things.]
As the previous family heads stepped down, Jin immediately headed to the head of the family's office.
In the office, Mary, the Tona brothers, and the stewards and secretaries were waiting.
Jin, as the head of the family, had no chance to feel the impression of stepping into the office for the first time, as he promptly sat down.
"Young Family Head, we've filtered it as much as we could, but there are still a lot of reports."
"As they are continuously coming in from various places, if you set the criteria today, we will try to minimize the reports in the future."
Mary and the Tona brothers said. Their attitudes towards Jin had changed, given the official occasion.
For a while, Jin looked at the brothers and smiled. He felt a sense of relief once again at the fact that they had all survived the war.
Among the stewards, there were also familiar faces.
However, the faces of the two stewards who would know the most secrets of the family were not seen.
"Are Chief Stewards Haintz and Howard dead?"
"...Yes, Young Family Head."
Petro answered.
"What about the documents they had?"
"Valeria had checked them during your absence, Young Family Head, but she couldn't find them. She says only the record remains that they were damaged even before the Demon God's death."
Jin decided to ignore it.
The most important of the past secrets would have been about Chiron. The reason Chiron dedicated his time to the Black Sea from his youth, the reason he eventually organized an expedition...
Anyway, Jin now seemed to know a bit of that reason.
'My father went to the Black Sea to avoid becoming a monster like the Demon God.'
He had felt such a conviction when he met Chiron in the underworld last time, and had been guessing since the moment he learned about the nature of the power called "Creation".
For a while, Jin silently looked over the reports.
Like the brothers, he was moved every time he confirmed the number of survivors.
"Petro."
"Yes!"

"Lend all the famous swords in the family's warehouse, which are stored and not being used, to the allied families and the empire. Picone will handle the rental fee measurement. The contract units are 5 years, and if rented for more than 20 years, it will be under the condition of transferring ownership. Use all the money generated from this for the stabilization of Huphester."
Petro wanted to ask if he was serious, but he just bowed his head.
"But don't force the rental. Only lend to families who are willing to borrow those swords, even if they have to open up their secret funds."
"Understood."

"Everyone must be surprised. There has never been a time in the last thousand years when the family's famous swords have been used like this. But now we need money. In addition to stabilizing Huphester, we need a large sum of money to produce fleets in the future. If necessary, we can just create more famous swords."

"When you say 'create'... Hmm, Young Family Head. Even in these circumstances, it is likely that the nose of the Master Blacksmiths Guild won't be lowered. Moreover, most of the weapons our family is lending are the works of the Guild, so if that fact becomes known, it would be even more so."
When one of the scribes spoke awkwardly, Jin looked around at his relatives.
The 'Anvil', 'Fire', and 'Hammer', the three masters of the Blacksmiths Guild, had a history of even rejecting the exclusive contract offered by Chiron in the past.

"When you all propose an opinion in the future, don't look around and just speak confidently. As long as it's not nonsense, I will never blame you. It's important that those of you who are quick-witted continue to voice your opinions."
"Understood!"

"I've already thought about weapon production through the Minche Blacksmith Guild. As some of you might know, Picone Minche, the origin and legendary blacksmith of the guild, is part of the Vamel Union. She is even the goddess of the current blacksmith, following Groller. She will personally step forward for the negotiations with the Guild."
The Minche Blacksmith Guild could not be overstated as being composed of Picone's extreme followers.
To put it bluntly, there was a high possibility that they would immediately agree if Picone asked for the position of the Guild's chairperson.
The reason for keeping the card called Picone until now was precisely for moments like this.

"Do not regret lending the famous swords. The allied martial artists will become stronger, we will make money and produce better weapons. In addition, those among the living swordsmen and knights who have shown a certain level of achievement will be given those swords."
Jin thought that in times of turmoil, most people are driven by personal goals and a sense of accomplishment rather than a greater cause.
"Petro, at this point, you must have an idea of what command I will give next?"
"I will dispose of all the treasures in the family, excluding those that have historical significance."

"Excellent. Discuss this part with the top of the Gold Coin. Sell everything through secret black market deals to the Rutero Union and the lands of the beasts. Remember, no matter how much you scrape together, money is always in short supply."
"Yes!"

"Also, for the time being, only five stewards and scribes, including Petro, will stay in the Garden of Swords. The rest are immediately dispatched to Huphester as a whole to report the local situation from time to time. The 7th batch will be in charge of the assignments."
"Yes."
"It seems like we've sorted out what we need to do financially within the family. Now, the problem we need to solve is manpower."
Highly skilled manpower for fleet production, magic engineers.
Getting them was key.
Now it had become an era when a war without a fleet was unimaginable.
The existence of magic engineers was essential to create the 'Golden Fleet'.
"We can secure some through the wizards in Huphester and the Empire, but it's not enough. Anyone have a suggestion on how to attract magic engineers?"
"I do."
Surprisingly, that voice was Valeria's.
She had just come into the office and heard Jin's voice.
"Valeria?"

"When I spoke to the previous lords earlier, they said that from now on, the lesser lord will put me in the forefront. There was no consultation with me, but since you're now the Lesser Lord of Runcandel, I can't just get angry..."
"Uh, I was going to ask."
Jin answered in a serious tone, trying his best.
Mary and Tona's brothers held back laughter until their faces turned red at this, and the stewards rolled their eyes as if they were in a difficult position.
Now, Valeria was really comfortable with Jin and his colleagues.

"Anyway, since I've decided to reveal my existence, I can probably recruit quite a lot of magic students by using that. As you know, there are quite a lot of wizards in this world who are crazy about the name 'Hister'."
In the past, people like Kidard Hol were typical.
'Hister' was indeed a legend and a myth to the magicians.
Especially to the wizards who received 'higher education' from Zipple and at least once visited their secret library.
At other times, Zipple would make a fuss the moment Jin recruited magicians through Hister's promotion, but not now.
Rather, it was a situation where Zipple had to look at Jin's face.

"The higher the wizard, the stronger their desire for Hister, so high-level personnel will naturally come. If Yuria is in charge of identity verification, we can also filter out the spies sent from Zipple."
"Good idea."
"However, I'd rather not have my face appear on those huge billboards where the Lesser Lord's appearance was drawn."
"I'll tell the Gold Coin executives. But it's best not to expect too much. They believe there's no more effective advertising than that. It actually worked well."
Valeria showed a dislike, but she didn't voice it out.
Jin let out a chuckle at her expression.
The meeting continued for about two hours afterwards.
It was all about Huphester's financial situation and reconstruction.
It was the first time a meeting was conducted in such a smooth atmosphere in this era.
It was a sight unseen when Chiron and Rosa ran the family.
"That should be roughly organized. The announcement will be made at noon tomorrow, and the location will be the Imperial Capital."
The moment Jin stood up from his seat to conclude the meeting, Mary met his eyes.
"Lesser Lord."
"Go ahead, 7th batch."
"You should visit the underground dungeon once."
"...Underground dungeon?"
Currently in the underground dungeon, the former 10th Knight Paddler Runcandel was imprisoned.
